Looking at this question about the paper "Capturing the start point of the virus–cell interaction with high-speed 3D single-virus tracking" (Nature Methods, 2022), I need to determine which buffer was used specifically for tracking free virus particles.

In this study, which involves high-speed 3D single-particle tracking of viruses, the researchers tracked free (unbound) virus particles in solution before they interacted with cells. For preparing and suspending free virus particles in a physiological solution for optical tracking, Dulbecco's phosphate buffered saline (DPBS) is the standard buffer used, as it maintains isotonicity and physiological pH conditions suitable for virus stability in solution.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
